dm.summary: I started with a look and did not reload. The desk was up to date: the Requests badge showed 4 waiting and a "New join request" toast had arrived on its own. On the Requests tab I opened each sheet with View sheet before approving, in the order Bram, Ada, Cass, Dev. I checked ratings, drives, resistance, gilds, gear and abilities against backend/vtt/creation.py, and all four are legal. Dev having only one resistance pip is correct, because resistance is 1 per 3 points in a drive. The odd action keys in SheetEditor (sneak, read) are just internal names for Read and Focus, so that is not a bug. Each approval wrote "X was approved into the circle." to the Activity Log. I welcomed each investigator at the table (#6). Circle formation has no separate start step: the papers opened on the players' desks when I approved them, and the Roster's "Circle formation so far" paper shows 0 of 4 on every part. I pressed Finalize once to read its warning ("Press again to seal the circle for good with 4 investigators, leaving 4 parts empty.") and then pressed Not yet, so the circle is NOT sealed. The Circle tab shows Stitch, Refresh and Train at 5/5 each before the seal, which matches the FAQ. I logged F015 (praise for the join review flow), F016 (ux, medium: the Lightkeeper's Circle charter can be edited during formation; from reading the source, the seal overwrites a name or ability set there, while a chapter house typed there silently replaces what the players wrote), F017 (ux, low: Finalize can be armed with no votes, and its warning does not name the empty parts) and F018 (praise: resources at 5 before the seal). F015 has one small error: after Approve the desk goes back to the request list with the next card showing, not straight to the next sheet. There were no console errors, and I told the table what happens next (#7).
dm.for_players:
The circle formation papers ("Form C.O. 4 · Circle formation") should now be open on your desk, because your investigator was approved. If they are not showing, report that as a finding. On a phone, a strip at the top jumps between the parts. Fill in every part:
1. I. Circle Question: click the question you want the circle to answer (your vote is marked). Then type your own answer in "Your personal answer" and click outside the box so it saves. Check that it says "Saved". The Lightkeeper reads every answer.
2. II. Name the Circle: type a name in "Circle name" and press Suggest or Enter. You get up to 5 suggestions. Then press Vote on the name you like best, even if it is your own. The name with the most votes wins, and a tie goes to the name voted for first.
3. III. Chapter House Location: one shared box for the whole circle. Agree on it at the table first, then have ONE person write it and click outside the box to save ("Saved"). Whatever is saved last replaces what anyone else wrote.
4. IV. Circle Ability: vote for one ability.
5. V. Insignia: vote for one symbol.
6. VI. Circle Relationships: for each of the other three investigators, propose a relationship (type and a line of history). When someone proposes one to you, accept or counter it.
7. Check the Starting Resource Points at the foot of the papers: they should read 5 (Stitch 5 · Refresh 5 · Train 5, from 1 + 4 investigators).
8. Say at the table when you are done. Do not wait for the others. The Lightkeeper seals the circle from her desk; you do nothing more on screen for that.

prompts.ada: Fill in all six parts of the formation papers. Check that resources read 5 each (1 + 4) and that a tie goes to the first vote, and log a rules finding if not. Nothing to roll yet.
prompts.bram: Find the formation papers on your phone and fill in all six parts (the strip at the top jumps between parts). Propose a relationship to each of the others. Nothing to roll yet.
prompts.cass: Fill in all six parts, and agree at the table who writes the chapter house. Try your edge cases (Enter twice on Suggest, a long name, a reload mid-answer), but leave a real vote in every part. Nothing to roll yet.
prompts.dev: Fill in all six parts. You could offer to write the chapter house for everyone once the table agrees, and propose relationships with some history. Nothing to roll yet.

dm.story_so_far: The Gullhaven Chapter was founded with code gullhaven-r4. Bram Okafor (ex-army Muscle), Professor Ada Quill (Scholar), Cass Moreau (Slink searching for her brother Jory, who vanished off the Gullhaven wharf) and Dev Lindqvist (Occultist) introduced themselves and were approved and welcomed. Before the dispatch about the Ferryman's Psalm can arrive, they are forming their circle on the formation papers.
